per_case_results.question: Paul di Resta was in the No. 853 race, what percent faster did he finish in the 853rd race than the next race for the fastest lap speed?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.raceId = 853 THEN T2.fastestLapSpeed::numeric ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.raceId = 854 THEN T2.fastestLapSpeed::numeric ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.raceId = 853 THEN T2.fastestLapSpeed::numeric ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.forename = 'Paul' AND T1.surname = 'di Resta'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT ((CAST(r1."fastestlapspeed" AS REAL) - CAST(r2."fastestlapspeed" AS REAL)) / CAST(r2."fastestlapspeed" AS REAL)) * 100
FROM "results" AS r1
JOIN "drivers" AS d ON r1."driverid" = d."driverid"
JOIN "races" AS ra1 ON r1."raceid" = ra1."raceid"
JOIN "results" AS r2 ON d."driverid" = r2."driverid"
JOIN "races" AS ra2 ON r2."raceid" = ra2."raceid"
WHERE d."forename" = 'Paul'
  AND d."surname" = 'di Resta'
  AND r1."raceid" = 853
  AND (ra2."date" > ra1."date" OR (ra2."date" = ra1."date" AND ra2."round" > ra1."round"))
ORDER BY ra2."date" ASC, ra2."round" ASC
LIMIT 1
